verdict.rationale: The CRA's own published pages document online completion of a founder's core transactions. Business Registration Online issues a BN and program accounts (GST/HST, payroll, corporation income tax) on one form, and the e-services pages state you can file a return, make a payment and register a business online. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the online flows complete end to end; the evidence is entirely vendor documentation.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Registering online is the fastest and easiest way to get a business number (BN) and certain CRA program accounts such as GST/HST and payroll.
You can register for a BN and the following CRA program accounts on one form
File a return, make a payment, register a business, get information, make an online request, calculate payroll deductions
